labels.description: Service providers are added as a stakeholder group whose business practices and positions may be attributed to Home Depot, adverse publicity is now a risk even when the company is not involved in the incident, regulatory issues join the list of sensitive topics, and regulatory investigations are added as a consequence of incomplete or inaccurate sustainability-related data and reporting.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: scope widened to service providers and third-party incidents in which the company is not involved, and criterion 1: investigations added as a new exposure tied to data and reporting on sensitive matters.

labels.description: The prior disclosure that inflation or deflation beyond the company's ability to respond could prevent price adjustments and hurt demand, margins or price competitiveness is deleted, while retailers operating reseller marketplaces and AI tools are newly named as competitive forces.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a previously disclosed risk (inflation/deflation pricing pressure) is removed, and criterion 2: reseller marketplaces and AI tools are newly referenced as sources of competition.

labels.description: A new statement warns that generative and agentic AI tools may dramatically change customer shopping and buying habits, geopolitical tensions, military conflicts, civil unrest and quarantines are added as trend drivers, real-time delivery status updates are added as a customer expectation, and the explicit reference to higher delivery costs from online sales concentration is dropped.
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a new risk from generative and agentic AI changing buying behavior is disclosed, and criterion 2: new geopolitical and military conflict drivers are referenced while the higher-delivery-cost exposure is removed.

labels.description: Risk that the investments and initiatives to deliver a frictionless interconnected experience (supply chain expansion, digital capabilities, store base maintenance and expansion, new store, branch and supply chain facility sites, AI technologies, strategic acquisitions) could disrupt operations or financial results and might not deliver the anticipated benefits.

Risk that the investments and initiatives to implement the interconnected retail strategy (supply chain and distribution network real estate projects, differentiated customer capabilities, aging store base, AI technologies, strategic acquisitions) could disrupt operations or financial results and might not deliver the anticipated benefits.

Mostly stylistic rewording ("strategic" alliances, "offer" instead of "market"), but the statement that supplier controversies "pose risks" to reputation and brand is softened to "could pose risks" and the claim that proprietary products differentiate the company is hedged to "help differentiate".
labels.rationale: criterion 3: applied literally, the change from an unconditional "pose risks" to a conditional "could pose risks" softens the characterization of the supplier-controversy risk, which is not an identical-meaning stylistic edit.

labels.description: The named reference to the acquisition of SRS in the second quarter of fiscal 2024 and the reference to the enforcement environment are dropped, while the ability to integrate new associates and unanticipated risks and liabilities are added as integration risks.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific named transaction (the SRS acquisition) and the enforcement environment reference are dropped, and criterion 1: integration of new associates is added as a new risk.

labels.description: The risk is broadened from key information technology systems to the company's entire technology infrastructure used to operate day-to-day business, with a new consequence that failures could prevent the company from accepting or fulfilling orders or providing services, AI activity escalated from testing the use of AI to testing, developing and deploying AI tools, and geopolitical tensions added as a cause.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: scope widened from IT systems to technology infrastructure, and criterion 1: a new exposure (inability to accept or fulfill orders) and deployment of AI tools are disclosed.
